**Flies** are insects of the order *Musca domestica*, known to live throughout North America, from New California to the Commonwealth. [3] 

## Characteristics[]

Unlike most bloatflies, the common house fly weathered the apocalypse without significant mutations. Their ecological niche remains unaltered as well, serving a vital role in the consumption of detritus. Much to the irritation of ghouls, this means that flies feed on the nutrients of their rotting bodies. [1] [4] [5] 

## Notes[]

## Appearances[]

Flies appear in *Fallout 2*, *Fallout 3*, *Fallout: New Vegas*, *Fallout 4*, and in *Fallout 76*.
